summary.text: Joan Meschino is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 3rd Plymouth District since January 2017 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Meschino won the 2016 election for the 3rd Plymouth District seat after incumbent Garrett Bradley resigned, defeating Republican Kristen Arute, and took office on January 4, 2017. She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026, with 99.3 percent of the vote.

For the 2025-2026 session, Meschino was assigned to the Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity and the Higher Education, Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, and Election Laws joint committees.

Ballotpedia's summary of her 2016 campaign website lists priorities that included regional work on climate change and sea level rise, early education funding, support for small businesses and tax relief for senior citizens.
